info.title: Knowledge Garden API
info.description: Dependency-free local, read-only API for an owner-curated, source-reviewed project catalog. GET and HEAD only; all other methods return 405. Unknown routes return 404. Query parameters must be listed for the endpoint and may occur only once. No authentication, remote proxy, telemetry, cross-origin access header or write endpoint is provided. Default bind: 127.0.0.1:4317. Host checks accept localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] and explicitly configured hosts. Request targets are bounded at 4096 characters and headers at 8192 bytes. Structural startup validation does not prove source assertions.
